$comment: Skill names a contract may record (contracts 2.9.0, 2.13.0). The enum lists the eight current names, then the deprecated names: the four of the hep-research 0.11.0 rename (hep-analysis -> hep-measurement, detector-response -> hep-detector, research-communication -> hep-authoring since 2.13.0, physics-ml -> hep-ml) and hep-communication -> hep-authoring (split into hep-citations and hep-authoring, contracts 2.13.0). A deprecated name passes the schema; contracts.skill_names reports it (warning, or an error under --strict-versions and protected use), and contracts/migrate_skill_names.py rewrites it. Keep in step with contracts/skill_names.py.
